form.label: Initial Setup
form.description: First-run initialization of KV Store inventory, last-seen baseline and canonical monitoring state.

init.set: Verifying inventory, last-seen observations and canonical state.

search.query: | eventcount summarize=false index=* | stats sum(count) AS events BY index | where index!="_internal" AND index!="_audit" AND index!="_introspection" | sort 0 index | fields index

| inputlookup lsw_inventory | stats count AS Inventory | appendcols [ | inputlookup lsw_lastseen | stats count AS Last_seen ] | appendcols [ | inputlookup lsw_state | stats count AS State ] | appendcols [ | inputlookup lsw_audit | stats count AS Audit ] | eval Missing_observation=if(Inventory>Last_seen,Inventory-Last_seen,0) | eval Banner_class=case( Inventory=0,"lsw-setup-status--required", State!=Inventory,"lsw-setup-status--attention", true(),"lsw-setup-status--success" ) | eval Banner_title=case( Inventory=0,"Initial Setup Required", State!=Inventory,"Initial Setup Needs Attention", true(),"Log Source Watch Successfully Initialized" ) | eval Banner_detail=case( Inventory=0,"No monitored sources are registered yet. Select an index, baseline and silence threshold, then initialize Log Source Watch.", State!=Inventory,"Inventory contains ".Inventory." sources but canonical state contains ".State.". Rebuild the state before relying on monitoring results.", Missing_observation>0,"Monitoring is initialized for ".Inventory." sources. ".Last_seen." currently have a last-seen observation and ".Missing_observation." are tracked as NO LOG OBSERVATION.", true(),"Monitoring is initialized for ".Inventory." sources and canonical state is complete." ) | fields Inventory Last_seen State Audit Banner_class Banner_title Banner_detail

| tstats latest(_time) AS seen WHERE index=$run_index|s$ earliest=$run_earliest|s$ latest=now BY index host | eval request_id=$run_nonce|s$ | where len(request_id)>0 AND $run_index|s$!="-" AND len(host)>0 AND len(host)<=255 AND NOT match(host,"[\x00-\x1F\x7F*?]") | eval _key=sha256(index."|".host), setup_threshold=tonumber($run_threshold|s$), setup_now=now() | lookup local=true lsw_inventory _key OUTPUT status AS old_status threshold_seconds AS old_threshold maintenance_until AS old_maintenance change_ref AS old_ref created_at AS old_created | eval license_increment=if(isnull(old_status),1,0) | lswlicenseguard increment_field=license_increment | eval status=coalesce(old_status,"active"), threshold_seconds=coalesce(old_threshold,setup_threshold), maintenance_until=coalesce(old_maintenance,0), change_ref=if(isnull(old_status),"setup-initial-enrollment",coalesce(old_ref,"setup-refresh")), created_at=coalesce(old_created,setup_now), updated_at=setup_now | fields _key index host status threshold_seconds maintenance_until change_ref created_at updated_at | outputlookup append=true key_field=_key allow_updates=true override_if_empty=false lsw_inventory | stats count AS rows

error.set: Inventory initialization failed. Check license capacity, index access and KV Store write permissions.

search.query: | tstats latest(_time) AS seen WHERE index=$run_index|s$ earliest=$run_earliest|s$ latest=now BY index host | where len(host)>0 AND len(host)<=255 AND NOT match(host,"[\x00-\x1F\x7F*?]") | eval _key=sha256(index."|".host) | lookup local=true lsw_inventory _key OUTPUT status AS inventory_status | where inventory_status="active" OR inventory_status="maintenance" | lookup local=true lsw_lastseen _key OUTPUT last_seen AS old_seen | eval last_seen=if(isnull(old_seen),seen,if(seen>old_seen,seen,old_seen)), updated_at=now() | fields _key index host last_seen updated_at | outputlookup append=true key_field=_key allow_updates=true override_if_empty=false lsw_lastseen | stats count AS rows

error.set: last_seen initialization failed. Check Job Inspector and lsw_lastseen.

search.query: | inputlookup lsw_inventory | lookup local=true lsw_lastseen _key OUTPUT last_seen updated_at AS lastseen_updated_at | `lsw_calculate_state` | eval state_updated_at=now() | fields _key index host status threshold_seconds threshold_minutes maintenance_until change_ref last_seen lastseen_updated_at age_seconds age_minutes effective_state alarm state_updated_at | outputlookup append=false key_field=_key allow_updates=true override_if_empty=true lsw_state | stats count AS rows

error.set: State build failed. Check lsw_inventory, lsw_lastseen and lsw_calculate_state.

search.query: | inputlookup lsw_inventory | stats count AS inventory | appendcols [ | inputlookup lsw_lastseen | stats count AS lastseen ] | appendcols [ | inputlookup lsw_state | stats count AS state ] | appendcols [ | inputlookup lsw_audit | stats count AS audit ] | eval missing_observation=if(inventory>lastseen,inventory-lastseen,0) | eval status=case(inventory=0,"SETUP REQUIRED",state!=inventory,"ATTENTION",true(),"READY") | eval message=case( status="SETUP REQUIRED","No sources were enrolled.", status="ATTENTION","Inventory contains ".inventory." sources but canonical state contains ".state.". Rebuild canonical state before relying on monitoring results.", missing_observation>0,"Initialization complete. ".inventory." sources are registered; ".missing_observation." are currently NO LOG OBSERVATION.", true(),"Initialization complete. Log Source Watch is ready." ) | fields status inventory lastseen state audit message

div.p: Verify the packaged KV Store schema, enroll the first source scope, seed latest observations and build canonical state.

html.div: Safe first run: recurring schedulers are enabled but last-seen collection remains fail-closed until inventory contains active or maintenance sources.

search.query: | inputlookup lsw_inventory | stats count AS Inventory | appendcols [ | inputlookup lsw_lastseen | stats count AS Last_seen ] | appendcols [ | inputlookup lsw_state | stats count AS State ] | appendcols [ | inputlookup lsw_audit | stats count AS Audit ] | eval Status=case(Inventory=0,"SETUP REQUIRED",State!=Inventory,"ATTENTION",true(),"READY") | table Status Inventory Last_seen State Audit

| inputlookup lsw_inventory | stats count AS records | eval collection="lsw_inventory" | append [ | inputlookup lsw_lastseen | stats count AS records | eval collection="lsw_lastseen" ] | append [ | inputlookup lsw_state | stats count AS records | eval collection="lsw_state" ] | append [ | inputlookup lsw_audit | stats count AS records | eval collection="lsw_audit" ] | eval availability="OK" | table collection availability records

| tstats latest(_time) AS last_seen WHERE index=$setup_index|s$ earliest=$setup_earliest|s$ latest=now BY index host | where $setup_index|s$!="-" AND len(host)>0 | eval _key=sha256(index."|".host) | lookup local=true lsw_inventory _key OUTPUT status AS existing_status threshold_seconds AS existing_threshold | eval registration=if(isnull(existing_status),"NEW","REGISTERED"), last_seen=strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table index host registration existing_status existing_threshold last_seen | sort 0 registration host

div.p: Initialize Log Source Watch enrolls the selected index/host sources, seeds lsw_lastseen, builds lsw_state immediately, and leaves the packaged five-minute schedulers running for ongoing monitoring.
KV Store collections and fields are defined by the application package. No manual KV Store creation is required.
